name: viper-supervisor-edition
description: V.I.P.E.R. Supervisor Edition — local-first ICAC command dashboard (desktop)
author: V.I.P.E.R.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n lan,web -c cyan,blue "npm run lan" "npm run dev"
scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n lan,web,app -c cyan,blue,magenta "npm run lan" "cross-env APP_PORT=3061 vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3061 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:3061 electron ."
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && npm run build:lan && electron-builder --dir -c.directories.output=C:/viper-build/release
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:lan && electron-builder --win nsis portable -c.directories.output=C:/viper-build/release
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run build:lan && electron-builder --win nsis portable -c.directories.output=C:/viper-build/release --publish always
